Intralism — моя самая любимая ритм игра. У меня была настоящая гиперфиксация на ней: каждая сессия, каждый трек просто поглощали меня с головой.
Коммьюнити у игры было относительно небольшое, поэтому часто приходилось создавать уровни с любимыми треками самому. Но это только добавляло удовольствия: ощущение, что даже твой простенький уровень значим и его могут заметить, невероятно мотивирует. В каком-то роде, сам редактор уровней мотивирует тебя творить. Он максимально прост в освоении.
Сама игра использует хорошо знакомую формулу easy to learn, hard to master, и это её главный плюс. Она минималистична — даже в геймплее. 
Многие ритм-игры я не люблю за их перегруженность, а здесь, как по мне, всё идеально.

[h1]Reseña de Intralism: ¡Ritmo y reflejos a prueba de bombas![/h1]

[h2]Resumen[/h2]
¿Alguna vez has sentido que tus dedos danzan sobre el teclado como si estuvieran en una discoteca de los 90? ¡Bienvenido a Intralism! Este juego es un campo de batalla rítmico donde tus reflejos y tu amor por la música electrónica se ponen a prueba mientras te conviertes en el DJ de tus pesadillas más frenéticas.

[h2]Aspectos importantes e interesantes[/h2]
La jugabilidad de Intralism es de otro mundo, literal. Tienes que sincronizar tus acciones con la música, y cada nivel parece estar diseñado por un DJ con demasiado café en sus venas. Lo interesante es la manera en que te reta a mejorar tus tiempos y precisión, haciéndote sentir como si fueras un partícipe de la fiesta más loca del universo.

[h2]Aspectos por mejorar[/h2]
Ah, pero no todo es un arcoíris de luces neón. La dificultad a veces puede sentirse como un golpe demasiado bajo, dejándote masticando el polvo de la frustración. Además, aunque los gráficos cumplen su propósito, podrían darle un poco más de glamour visual a la fiesta. Y una pizca más de variedad en las pistas no le haría daño a nadie.

This probably has it's fans but I am not one of them.

No player feedback, difficult to read notes, horrid judgement line, wonky controls, and no difficulty system. Concept could work fine if these details where fixed. But even the, the way the notes are displayed is very questionable. Like, I get they didn't wanna make another 4k rhythm game, but the fact that the notes start big in the middle of your screen and get smaller until they fill the judgement line makes reading notes insanely difficult. Not in the "oh, the game's just hard" kinda way, but the "wow this design choice was not thought out very well" kinda way. 

The base controls for this game are terrible if you're trying to do anything that's even remotely hard, WASD and arrow keys do not work for doing fast paced sections, as hitting vertical keys in games like this just doesn't work, there's no way to comfortably position your fingers in a way. 

The worst aspect of this game is that unlike a lot of its competitors, this costs money. You spend $5 to get a game with half the polish of majority of the free alternatives for rhythm games, such as Osu! or Quaver. 

Unless this style REALLY peaks your interest, I would stay clear of this game.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.
